crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king…
But Yahweh’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.
Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and…
God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.
Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
